main.description: A buyer-owned review, living in the reviewer's repo so authorship is preserved and the review is portable across applications. It carries no self-asserted verification: whether a purchase actually happened is a claim for a separate attestation record issued by someone other than the review author, and each application decides which issuers it trusts.

subject.description: AT URI of what is being reviewed: a productGroup or standalone listing (a durable, product-level anchor), or a shop. Shop-level reviews are what make seller reputation portable and keep it from vanishing when a seller relists.

variantSnapshot.description: Denormalized variant properties captured at review time (e.g. [{axis: Color, value: Red}]). Self-contained and not anchored to a live variant listing, so restructuring variants leaves reviews valid and filterable. Absent when the subject is a shop.

images.description: Buyer's own photographs of what arrived
